name: Instant Ramen with Egg and Vegetables
summary: Packet ramen made into a meal with an egg, frozen vegetables, and a spoon of peanut butter. Ten minutes.
instructions: Bring 2 L of water to a boil in a large pot. Add the frozen vegetables and cook 2 minutes.
Add the noodle blocks. Stir in only 3 of the 6 seasoning packets. The full set is very salty.
Crack the eggs into the pot, spaced apart. Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook 3 minutes until the whites set.
In each bowl, stir together a little peanut butter, soy sauce, and sesame oil with a splash of the hot broth.
Divide the noodles, eggs, vegetables, and broth between the bowls. Top with green onion and chili flakes.

substitutions.substitute: 400 g rice noodles, with 900 mL gluten-free broth in place of the seasoning packets
substitutions.costNote: Rice noodles about $1.97 plus broth $1.69 (estimate); total stays under $10
Small bottle about $3–$4; you use very little

glutenFree.notes: Instant noodles and their seasoning packets contain wheat. Eggs, vegetables, and peanut butter are naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Instant noodles go on sale at No Frills for as little as $0.37 a pack, so it is worth stocking up when they do.
Using half the seasoning packets cuts the sodium a lot without losing much flavour. The peanut butter and soy make up the difference.
Any leftover cooked meat, tofu, or frozen spinach can go in with the vegetables.
